title: The rainy tram window
alt: A tram passenger holding a yellow book looks into her reflection in a rain-streaked window.
description: A cinematic portrait combines natural hands, layered reflections and a richly lit transport interior.
prompt: Film still shot inside a vintage green tram at night. A woman in a dark wool coat holds a closed mustard-yellow book in her lap, looking out through a rain-streaked window. Her face and its faint reflection appear face-to-face on opposite sides of the vertical edge of the window. Outside are blurred red lights and wet shops. Warm brass handrail, real wet glass, soft tungsten interior. Natural subdued portrait with both the seated passenger and her reflection visible. No lettering.
